Cześć! 😊 Szukam castingów filmowych, serialowych, reklamowych lub do różnych projektów aktorskich w Warszawie. Mam 16 lat i bardzo chciałabym spróbować swoich sił przed kamerą oraz zdobyć nowe doświadczenie.

Od 10 lat interesuję się tańcem i mam doświadczenie w różnych stylach, m.in. modern jazz i akrobatyce. Jestem otwarta na nowe wyzwania, szybko się uczę i chętnie spróbuję swoich sił również w innych projektach, np. filmach, serialach, teledyskach czy programach telewizyjnych. 🎬

Jeśli ktoś zna aktualne castingi dla osób w moim wieku w Warszawie lub okolicach, będę bardzo wdzięczna za informacje albo kontakt do osób zajmujących się rekrutacją! ❤️ Z góry dziękuję!

GET OUT OF YOUR HEAD. TRUST YOUR INSTINCTS. RESPOND TRUTHFULLY.

What happens when you stop trying to get it right and start really listening?

When you allow yourself to be affected by the person in front of you, rather than trying to create a performance?

That’s where the Meisner work begins.

Join Lorna Dempsey for our two-day MEISNER FOUNDATION INTENSIVE — an opportunity to explore truthful, spontaneous acting, moment to moment.

Whether you’re new to Meisner, looking to deepen your craft or considering our Core Actor Training, come and experience the work for yourself.

🎭 24–25 OCTOBER 2026
📍 The Cockpit Theatre, London
💷 £165

BOOK NOW — LINK IN BIO

Our final Foundation before Core Actor Training begins on 5 November.

#MeisnerTechnique #MeisnerInstituteLondon #ActorTraining #ActingClassesLondon #MeisnerFoundation ActingWorkshop

That’s a wrap on my recent casting 🎉 whether it’s resharing my posts, referrals, submitting yourself, time, work ethic..building rapport with  people who reach out to me for casting because they trust me means more than you know! 🫶🎬  so THANK YOU! 

“Luck is when preparation meets opportunity” Keep putting yourself out there..you never know when the next door will open! 

As always, stay tuned till next time! 👋
Teresa Mason Casting

Seven Minutes
SEEKING ROLES:

Stella 18-24: depressed, Stella struggles to cope with the grief of living and finding a purpose in what life could be

Emory 18-24: Bubbly and optimistic, always tries to see the good in the bad. Attempts to get Stella to let her in more

Mom 30s-70s (ability to portray a mom): Forgiving, just wants the best for her daughter and tries to show up in different ways

Paramedic Any ages: Quick on their feet, uses the best of their time.

Dominic 18-24: arrogant, goes about life in a way that he is the main character, very narcissistic

Unpaid Student film

We’re shooting from November 6th to the 8th. Potential pickups, the following week (TBD).

Logline: A depressed young woman gets into a tragic accident and is forced to confront her life in the span of seven minutes.

Contact: chloeewilson018@gmail.com if you’re interested

Hello again! Sorry for such short notice, BUT I am posting this casting call looking for some EXTRA's / BACKGROUND! We're shooting on old timey film, and I would love for scene to be lively with some people :). I attached some screen grabs from the rehearsal we did to show the look we're going for, except the real thing will be more authentic and not just me playing on Premiere haha.

I am mostly looking for someone to play a PARENT and a CHILD! They have this biggest part in interacting with the street mime. Everyone will be asked to run and clear frame at a certain point in the scene as well, so if you cannot run you might not want to come to this one.

*Compensation is copy of the footage (UPON REQUEST) and an IMDB Credit once the film is released :)

If you'd like to be a part of this, please email me :)

We're shooting on old timey film, and I would love for scene to be lively with some people :). I attached some screen grabs from the rehearsal we did to show the look we're going for, except the real thing will be more authentic and not just me playing on Premiere haha.

I am mostly looking for someone to play a PARENT and a CHILD! They have this biggest part in interacting with the street mime. Everyone will be asked to run and clear frame at a certain point in the scene as well, so if you cannot run you might not want to come to this one.

*Compensation is copy of the footage (UPON REQUEST) and an IMDB Credit once the film is released :)

If you'd like to be a part of this, please email me :)

Hey everyone! We’re a team of LA-based indie filmmakers that are part of a community bringing together people working in movies across Los Angeles. Just good people, great conversations, and real connections. We welcome people at every level of their career.

Our mission is simple: Help each other make movies, connect, and network.

We meet in Boyle Heights every 1st Thursday of the month at 6pm.

Whether you're an actor, filmmaker, writer, producer, director, DOP, or working behind the scenes, we'd love for you to join us!

Entrance is FREE, but RSVP is required as space is limited.

**RSVP here:** https://partiful.com/e/lY9sDO0ZosP3nr2bcNVl?c=Y6ysr1LC

Hope to see some of you there! Feel free to share this with anyone in the LA film and TV community.

Drinks and snacks available for purchase.

It is a sapphic romance and thriller short film - set in a retro-futuristic world. Filming will take place in Cheltenham and Gloucester around early to end of November this year (dates to be decided). Travel expenses will be covered and food will be provided.

If you are interested please email me at emmamgfilm@gmail.com and or send me a message through here 🙏 alongside please list your availability in November 

Thanks, Emma :)

items.text:
What do casting directors REALLY notice when you walk into a dance audition?
We’re bringing award-winning Pearson Casting to Liverpool for an exclusive Audition Technique for Dancers Intensive!

Experience a mock professional dance audition, learn choreography and receive honest, constructive feedback from the other side of the casting table.

Discover what casting directors look for, how you come across in the room, what makes you memorable and why getting the choreography wrong isn’t always the biggest issue.

Plus, a Q&A with Pearson Casting, giving you the chance to ask those all-important industry questions.

With credits including SIX, Operation Mincemeat, Starlight Express, RENT and High School Musical, this is an incredible opportunity for North West performers to learn directly from an award-winning international casting team.

Monday 7th December | Liverpool

3-hour intensive | £25

No job on the line. Just the opportunity to learn, make mistakes and grow.

Bookings: https://bookwhen.com/wirraltowestend

This workshop adheres to CDG guidelines and is not an audition.

Wirral To West End

Starting November 2026.

Exciting nightclub opportunity for female fire performers and dancers.

Contract Details:

* Salary: $1,200 USD per month

* Accommodation provided

* Transportation provided

* One meal per day

* Return flight ticket covered up to $300

* Visa provided

Work Schedule:

**STATISTER SØGES TIL AFGANGSFILM – DEN DANSKE FILMSKOLE**

Til afgangsfilmen *ANGELS*, instrueret af Jonatan Egholm Keis og produceret af Astrid Andreasen, søger vi statister af alle typer, køn og aldre til at agere familiemedlemmer/venner til et sølvbryllup.

**Dato:** Torsdag d. 15. oktober

**Tidsrum:** ca. 09.00-19.00

**Sted:** Storkøbenhavn

Lyder det som dig - eller kender du nogen? Så hører vi meget gerne fra dig!

Send en mail til statisten.nu@gmail.com med navn, alder, kontaktoplysninger og et vellignende billede.

Hvis du er under 18 år bedes du desuden angive navn og kontaktoplysninger på en forælder/værge.

Skriv: FESTGÆST i emnefeltet.

*OBS: Kun henvendelser via mail vil blive besvaret.*

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

***Om filmen***

*ANGELS er en rockerfilm uden læderveste, motorcykler, narko og pistoler. Det er en moderne gangsterfilm til den tid, vi lever i, som fokuserer på mennesket bag den kriminelle etikette.*

Deltagelse er ulønnet, men der vil være forplejning på set.

sharedPost.text:
✨🎭 ANNOUNCING OUR NEXT BIG SHOW: CHITTY CHITTY BANG BANG JR. AT EDEN COURT! 🎭✨

The secret is finally out! We are absolutely thrilled to announce that the Academy of Creative Theatre will be bringing the musical magic of Chitty Chitty Bang Bang Jr. to Eden Court on Saturday 2nd October 2027! 🚗💨✨

Get ready to join the eccentric inventor Caractacus Potts, his adventurous children Jemima and Jeremy, and the delightful Truly Scrumptious as they outsmart the Baron of Vulgaria and the notorious Child Catcher. Our incredibly talented cast of young performers is ready to take you on a truly scrumptious journey filled with unforgettable songs, high-energy choreography, and plenty of theatrical magic. 🎶🌟

📆 SAVE THE DATE!

🌟Show Date: Saturday 2nd October 2027
🌟Venue: Eden Court, Inverness
Show times, and ticket release dates will be announced closer to the time, so keep your eyes glued to our page! 👀🎟️

🌟 WANT TO BE A PART OF THE ACT FAMILY?
Before we fly away in our magical car, we still have an action-packed term ahead of us after the holidays, including  
🎤The Press and Journal concert, 
 🏔️Cairngorm Mountain Resort Santa Grotto,
🎅 Wee Stars mini Xmas performance,
 🎄Singing at Simpsons! 🧙‍♀️❄️🎄

If your child wants to join the fun, build confidence, and be part of our performance opportunities, two-week trials are available starting Saturday 31st October:

⭐ Wee Stars (Ages 4–6) & Exam Classes: £20
🎭 Academy Workshops (Ages 7–18): £50

🌐 Find out more and enrol today:
actinverness.com

Have a fantastic, well-deserved half-term break, everyone! We can't wait to see our ACT stars back in action soon.⭐🎭

CHITTY CHITTY BANG BANG JR.
Music and Lyrics by Richard M. Sherman and Robert B. Sherman
Music by Special Arrangement with Sony/ATV Publishing  by
Adapted for the Stage by Jeremy Sams
Based on the MGM Motion Picture
Licensed Script Adapted by Ray Roderick 
Chitty Chitty Bang Bang JR. is presented through special arrangement with Music Theatre International (MTI). 
All authorised performance materials are also supplied by MTI. www.mtishows.co.uk

items.text:
🎬 LITTLE STARS: Getting Your Kids Into Acting & Modeling ⭐

I've had quite a few people ask how we got our twins into acting, so I thought it would be fun to start sharing our experience!

I'll be sharing how we got started, what I've learned along the way, and tips and tricks for other parents who might be interested in getting their own little ones into acting or modeling!
I'm definitely no expert, but we've learned SO much over the last few months, and I'm happy to share what I can! 

⭐ PART 1: The Origin Story

It all started when I was out walking with a friend at a park by a lake.
She asked me if I'd ever considered getting the twins into acting. Her little girl had done some gigs, and apparently they LOVE babies with lots of hair!

Well, my twins were 100% BALD at the time. 😝😂
I was basically like, "Oh, that sounds fun! Maybe!"

But over the next couple of days, I started thinking about the comparison aspect of it all.
What if one twin got picked for something and the other didn't? I really didn't want my girls being compared to each other, especially at such a young age.

So I decided it probably wasn't for us.
Meanwhile, my moms group, The SAHM Club: San Diego, was really taking off, and I was getting SUPER busy with that. Honestly, I completely forgot about the whole acting thing.
Then one day, I'm scrolling Instagram, and my friend sends me a casting flyer. Or maybe she texted it? I honestly can't remember. 

They were looking for Caucasian identical twin girls for a recurring role on a television show.
Well, I just happened to have two of those! 

And the best part? Since they were looking for identical twins to share a role, the whole comparison issue that had bothered me wasn't really a concern anymore.

So I figured, WHY NOT?

I took a few pictures of the girls and sent them in.
The picture I'm sharing with this post is actually one of the original photos I submitted! 🥹
And that's how this whole adventure started!
I had absolutely NO idea what we were getting ourselves into. 

🎬 Coming up in Part 2: What happened after I submitted their photos!

Have you ever considered getting your kids into acting or modeling? Or is it something you've always been curious about?

Drop your questions below! I'll try to answer as many as I can throughout this series! ❤️

#LittleStars #ChildActing #BabyModeling #MomLife #WranglingThree

Cześć! Szukam dwóch epizodystów mężczyzn azjatyckiego pochodzenia, najlepiej chińskiego, do jednej sceny w krótkim metrażu realizowanym w ramach Warszawskiej Szkoły Filmowej.

Poszukiwani aktorzy:

* Aktor 1: około 30 lat
* Aktor 2: około 50 lat

📅 Terminy zdjęć: 25 i 26 października 2026 r. (Autor 30 lat tylko jeden dzień zdjęciowy ).

⏱️ Czas pracy: do 6 godzin.

💰 Wynagrodzenie: zdjęcia są płatne.

Jeśli jesteś zainteresowany, proszę o wiadomość prywatną z następującymi informacjami:

* aktualne zdjęcie (najlepiej portretowe i sylwetkowe),
* wiek,
* wzrost,
* doświadczenie aktorskie (jeśli posiadasz),
* dostępność w podanych terminach.

Będę wdzięczna za zgłoszenia oraz udostępnienia! 😊

Do zobaczenia na planie! 🎥

🎬 CASTING / POSZUKUJEMY 2 MODELEK / AKTOREK DO NAGRYWEK REELS  DLA HOTELU ****
Do udziału nagraniach wideo dla 4-gwiazdkowego hotelu w centrum Gdańska poszukujemy dwóch doświadczonych modelek / aktorek, które wcielą się w role dwóch przyjaciółek.

KOGO SZUKAMY?

💃🏻💃🏻2 KOBIETY (rola: przyjaciółki / duo)
 
• Wiek wizualny: ścisłe 35–40 lat (Bardzo prosimy o samokrytykę i zgłoszenia wyłącznie osób wpisujących się w ten przedział wiekowy.) 

• Uroda: naturalna, dojrzała, elegancka. Warunek konieczny: zero widocznych zabiegów medycyny estetycznej.

• Wymagane: realne doświadczenie przed kamerą / w wideo, swoboda oraz umiejętność budowania naturalnej relacji na planie. 

SZCZEGÓŁY PLANU:
📍 Lokalizacja: Gdańsk (Centrum)
📅 Termin zdjęć: [28 lub 29.10.]
💰 Wynagrodzenie: Płatne 

JAK SIĘ ZGŁOSIĆ?
Prosimy o zgłoszenia według briefu
z dostępnością terminów. Zgłoszenia 
przyjmowane są w wiadomości prywatnej (PRIV) i powinny zawierać:

1. Imię, nazwisko, wiek
2. Wzrost, dokładne wymiary oraz rozmiar odzieży / obuwia
3. Kilka aktualnych zdjęć (twarz bez filtrow / mocnego makijażu + sylwetka)
4. Materiały wideo (wideo-wizytówka, showreel lub krótkie nagranie przedstawiające sylwetkę i emocje przed kamerą)

Czekamy na Was w wiadomościach  - odezwiemy się do wybranych osób. 
Do zobaczenia na planie! 🤌💫

S.

Cześć!!! 🎬🎥
Do najnowszego odcinka Trudnych Spraw, poszukiwani odtwórcy poniższych ról:

1.BORYS GABRYSIAK (45) – gangster i wierzyciel Jakuba. SCENY: 4, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10, 11 – 7 scen. 
INTRO: 1.
Wygląd: Przypakowany, tatuaże, ostentacyjny „osiedlowy gangster”; dres, złoty łańcuch, rzucający się w oczy zegarek.
Szczegóły: Czarny charakter, ale nie karykatura. Groźny, bezczelny, inteligentny i zdolny błyskawicznie wykorzystać cudzą słabość. Przy Julii potrafi udawać sympatycznego, co wymaga dobrego przełączania energii aktorskiej.
📆26-28.10

2.BARBARA NOWACZYK (54) – matka Jakuba. 
SCENY: 7, 9, 10, 14, 16, 25, 26 – 7 scen.
Wygląd: Sterana życiem 54-latka, mogąca wyglądać nieco starzej. Po udarze konieczna wiarygodna zmiana fizyczna.
Szczegóły: Kochająca, ale wielokrotnie zawiedziona przez syna. Aktorka musi bardzo dobrze zagrać stan po rozległym udarze: początkowo ciężki niedowład lewej strony, potem stopniową poprawę. W scenie 25 dochodzą problemy z chodzeniem, a w 26 stan jest już znacznie lepszy.
📆26-27.10

3.ADAM JABŁOŃSKI (27) – znajomy Jakuba z dawnego środowiska. 
SCENY: 18, 19 OFF – 2 sceny.
Wygląd: Typ osiedlowego drobnego kombinatora, sportowy styl. 
Szczegóły: Kusi Jakuba możliwością szybkiego, nielegalnego zarobku. W scenie 19 występuje wyłącznie głosem przez telefon.
📆27-28.10

4.JERZY NOWACZYK (57) – ojciec Jakuba. 
SCENY: 20, 21 – 2 sceny.
Wygląd: Zaniedbany, zniszczony alkoholem mężczyzna. Szczegóły: Manipulant i oportunista. Powinien początkowo sprawić wrażenie człowieka, który może rzeczywiście martwić się o Barbarę, aby późniejsze ujawnienie jego prawdziwych intencji zadziałało.
📆27-28.10

5.WALDEMAR MOREŃ (30) – biologiczny ojciec Julii, były mąż Doroty. 
SCENY: 22, 23 – 2 sceny.
Wygląd: Dobrze ubrany 30-latek, pod którego normalnym wyglądem kryje się agresor. 
Szczegóły: Podpity, agresywny i przemocowy. Musi być wiarygodnym zagrożeniem dla Doroty, ale zgodnie z charakterem pasma nie powinien być przerysowany.
📆26.10

6.ADRIANNA LASOTA (60) – sąsiadka Barbary. 
SCENA: 12 – 1 scena.
📆26.10

📍Wrocław 

💸gotówka po planie 

📩Zainteresowane i dostępne osoby proszę o kontakt w wiadomość prywatnej.

🇩🇪 Musik verbindet – ein starkes Zeichen für Frieden, Respekt und Zusammenhalt! ❤️🕊️

Beim Interview mit dem Bavarka-Trio im Rahmen unseres Benefiz-Gesangswettbewerbs durften wir besondere Menschen kennenlernen, die nicht nur mit ihrer Musik berühren, sondern auch eine wichtige Botschaft vermitteln.

Gerade in diesen bewegenden Zeiten, in denen die Politik und die Ereignisse im Osten Europas uns alle beschäftigen, setzen sie mit ihrer Musik ein Zeichen für Menschlichkeit, gegenseitigen Respekt und Toleranz. 🙏❤️

Besonders schön: Das Trio hat ein eigenes Lied geschrieben und beim Benefiz-Gesangswettbewerb gesungen. Ein Lied, das von Herzen kommt und eine Botschaft trägt! 🎶✨

📺 Bleibt dran! Schon bald wird der Benefiz-Gesangswettbewerb bei unserem JSW Fernsehen ausgestrahlt. Freut euch auf das Bavarka-Trio und viele weitere tolle Sängerinnen und Sänger!

Musik kennt keine Grenzen – sie verbindet Menschen und schenkt Hoffnung. ❤️🎤

#BavarkaTrio #BenefizGesangswettbewerb #MusikVerbindet #Frieden #Respekt #Toleranz #Menschlichkeit #JSWFernsehen #MusikMitHerz #Zusammenhalt

🇷🇺 Музыка объединяет — важный знак мира, уважения и единства! ❤️🕊️

Во время интервью с Bavarka-Trio в рамках нашего благотворительного песенного конкурса мы познакомились с замечательными людьми, которые трогают сердца не только своей музыкой, но и важным посланием.

В наше непростое время, когда события в политике и происходящее в Восточной Европе волнуют всех нас, они своим творчеством несут миру послание человечности, взаимного уважения и терпимости. 🙏❤️

Особенно приятно, что трио исполнило песню собственного сочинения! Это музыка, идущая от сердца и несущая важный смысл. 🎶✨

📺 Оставайтесь с нами! Уже скоро благотворительный песенный конкурс будет показан на нашем телеканале JSW Fernsehen. Вас ждёт выступление Bavarka-Trio, а также многих других замечательных певиц и певцов!

Музыка не знает границ — она объединяет людей и дарит надежду. ❤️🎤

#BavarkaTrio #БлаготворительныйКонкурс #МузыкаОбъединяет #Мир #Уважение #Толерантность #Человечность #JSWFernsehen #МузыкаОтСердца #Единство

📸 200 € pro Drehtag | Foto- & Videodrehs

Für unsere Fahrradmarke Alphatrail suchen wir sympathische Darsteller (m/w/d) aus Regensburg und Umgebung, die Lust haben, bei professionellen Foto- und Videodrehs mitzuwirken.

✅ 200 € pro Drehtag

✅ 3–5 Drehtage innerhalb eines Monats

✅ Flexible Termine (teilweise wetterabhängig)

✅ Fahrrad & Helm werden gestellt

✅ Erste Kameraerfahrung von Vorteil, aber kein Profi notwendig!

Du solltest sicher Fahrrad fahren, natürlich vor der Kamera wirken und zeitlich flexibel sein.

📩 Interesse? Schick uns einfach eine PN mit deinem Wohnort, 2–3 aktuellen Fotos und deiner zeitlichen Verfügbarkeit.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Nachricht! 😊

ER DU GOD TIL AT LYVE? VI SØGER FRIVILLIGE DELTAGERE TIL EN YOUTUBE-VIDEO I MORGEN! (
Er du god til at lyve, fortælle historier og tage lidt pis på andre? Så søger vi dig!

Vi er Chris & Jacob, og vi mangler 3 personer (18+) til en sjov YouTube-video, vi optager i morgen!

Konceptet:

Vi samler 5 deltagere, som hver især har én vild, sjov eller usædvanlig historie fra deres liv.

Vi skal igennem 5 runder, hvor alle deltagere fortæller deres version af den samme historie. Men kun én fortæller sandheden, mens de andre 4 skal forsøge at lyve sig igennem!

Vores opgave er at afhøre jer og finde ud af, hvem der faktisk har oplevet historien.

Du behøver ikke være skuespiller eller verdensmester i at lyve! I får historiernes overskrifter på forhånd, så I kan forberede jer.

Vi søger bare nogle friske, udadvendte personer med god humor, som har lyst til at være med på kamera!

Praktisk info:

Søndag den 18. oktober kl. 15.00-18.00( konservativt sat, nok kortere)

Amager, København

18+

Det er frivillig og ulønnet deltagelse.

VIL DU VÆRE MED?

Send en SMS til  Mandarina på 31 49 55 65 med:

* Dit navn og alder
* En kort beskrivelse af en vild, sjov, pinlig eller usædvanlig sand historie fra dit liv

Vi mangler kun 3 deltagere, så skriv meget gerne allerede i dag!

topComments.text: If this company uses AI slop for their posters, how badly are they going to treat their other artists?

Please don't use #AIslop for casting calls. 🙁
AI is MURDERING HUMAN BEINGS. If that's not reason enough to stop using it, I don't know what is. 💔
#AIslop should not be used by Casting professionals and other industry pros, to officially communicate with actors, either as casting calls, promo posts, advertisements or other messages.
The simple facts that AI was founded on the STOLEN work of actors and other artists; and has become such a volatile disruptor of our entire industry, causing the loss of jobs, the cheapening of our art form, not to mention the very real destruction of our environment, which MOST artists care deeply about...
That alone should be enough for the pros to acknowledge and be sensitive to the fact that using the technology is disrespectful to the actors they work with.

STAFFING BOSTON CELTICS & BRUINS!!
Branded Promo Talent, a leading experiential marketing agency, is seeking reliable, enthusiastic, and professional Brand Ambassadors to represent TD Bank at Boston Celtics and Boston Bruins home games at TD Garden in Boston, MA!

Event 1: Celtics

Friday, October 23, 2026

3:00 PM – 9:00 PM (TBC)

Event 2: Bruins

Saturday, October 24, 2026

3:00 PM – 9:00 PM (TBC)

Location:

TD Garden

100 Legends Way

Boston, MA 02114

Compensation:

Team Lead — $35 per hour

Brand Ambassadors — $30 per hour

— 1099, paid weekly —

Parking:

Parking reimbursed with receipt.

Attire:

Branded t-shirts will be provided. Wear black pants (no leggings, sweatpants, or ripped/torn jeans) with clean, comfortable white sneakers. Long-sleeved black or white layers may be worn underneath the branded shirt, and black jackets are permitted as needed for colder weather.

Event Details: 

TD Bank is bringing game-day excitement to TD Garden for back-to-back home games featuring the Boston Celtics on Friday and the Boston Bruins on Saturday! Brand Ambassadors will be stationed throughout the exterior plaza and indoor concourse areas, engaging with fans, creating personalized player trading cards, and assisting with interactive games.

Team Lead Duties: 

• Must have experience leading large teams. 

• Oversee staff and coordinate team assignments. 

• Ensure smooth event execution and client communication. 

• Capture event photos and submit recaps.

Staff Duties:

• Assist with event prep, execution, and breakdown to ensure smooth operations.

• Engage with fans, communicate key brand messaging, and guide guests through the activation. 

• Maintain a fun, welcoming, and energetic atmosphere to create memorable fan experiences. 

• Support event activities, manage guest flow, and assist with giveaways.

Staff Expectations: 

We want high-energy, outgoing, and engaging Brand Ambassadors who know how to hype a crowd and create great vibes. You must be punctual, professional, and ready to bring it from start to finish!

Application Process:

To be considered, email chrissy@brandedpromotalent.com with the following:

• Availability

• Resume

• Headshot

• Relevant experience

• A brief description of why you're an excellent fit for this role.

Please use "TD Garden - Celtics & Bruins" as the subject of your email.

Note: Only applicants who follow all instructions will be considered. Our team will review qualifications via email and schedule a call with eligible candidates.

Casting Call 

Archive House Productions is filming a docuseries exploring the legacy of the pilgrims' and their role in shaping America's cultural heritage.

Szukamy osób do badania dotyczącego systemów POS w gastronomii 🍽️
Prowadzimy badanie na temat systemów POS i rozwiązań kasowych wykorzystywanych w lokalach gastronomicznych i szukamy osób, które mają praktyczne doświadczenie z ich wyborem lub codziennym użytkowaniem.

👤 Kogo szukamy?

właścicieli lokali gastronomicznych,

managerów,

osób odpowiedzialnych za wybór systemu POS / kasy,

osób, które mają realną wiedzę na temat użytkowanego w lokalu rozwiązania.

💬 Na czym polega badanie?

Zapraszamy na około 60-minutową rozmowę online, podczas której porozmawiamy o doświadczeniach związanych z systemem POS, jego wyborem, użytkowaniem oraz potrzebami lokalu.

Na początku zadamy kilka krótkich pytań, żeby sprawdzić, czy profil uczestnika i lokalu pasuje do założeń badania.

💰 Wynagrodzenie za udział: 300 zł

Jeśli prowadzisz lokal gastronomiczny lub odpowiadasz w nim za system POS i chciał(a)byś podzielić się swoim doświadczeniem, napisz do mnie w wiadomości prywatnej.

Dziękuję! 🙌

🚨  CASTING – DZIEWCZYNKA 6–10 LAT | NAGRANIA JUŻ JUTRO (18.10)! 🚨
do produkcji internetowej pilnie poszukujemy dziewczynki w wieku 6–10 lat, najlepiej drobnej, o młodym wyglądzie.
�📅 Termin: JUTRO, 18.10 (niedziela)�🕒 Godziny: wieczorne/nocne (nagrania po zmroku)�📍 Lokalizacja: okolice Warszawy�🎭 Rola: DZIEWCZYNKA (klimat horroru)
Zależy nam na niepokojącym, lekko przerażającym sposobie gry – powolne ruchy głową, spokojne, wolne wypowiadanie kwestii, na wzór dzieci z horrorów.

📩 ZGŁOSZENIA:
Ze względu na bardzo pilny termin prosimy o przesyłanie zgłoszeń OD RAZU Z NAGRANĄ PRÓBKĄ AKTORSKĄ na podstawie scenki załączonej do posta.

Self-tape może być nagrany telefonem, a kwestie pozostałych postaci czytane zza kamery.

W zgłoszeniu prosimy o podanie wieku dziewczynki, przesłanie aktualnego zdjęcia oraz nagrania self-tape. Zgłoszenia na messengerze pv. Odpowiadam na wybrane zgłoszenia.

أنا ببحث عن فرصة شغل في مجال Animation ، وهكون موجود ف الغردقه  يوم 5 سبتمبر.
أنا طالب جامعي، ومتفرغ للشغل.
 بتكلم إنجليزي كويس، وعندي خبرة في التعامل مع الناس والضيوف والأنشطة الترفيهية والرقص، ومستعد أتعلم وأطور من نفسي وأشتغل مع أي فريق محترف.

لو فيه فرصه متاحة  ياريت حد يتواصل معايا أو يدلني عليها، ويفضل أعرف قبل ما أجي عشان لو محتاج أعمل أي ورق أو إجراءات أقدر أجهزها قبل السفر.
 

وشكرًا مقدمًا ❤️

FLIGHTTIME PRODUCTIONS
FINAL OPEN CASTING CALL

Diva Airways: The Rise & Fall

A Three-Act Comedy-Drama | World Premiere – Chicago, 2027

NON-UNION ACTORS ONLY | PAID PERFORMANCE OPPORTUNITIES

Dear Performers,

FlightTime Productions is excited to officially announce our Final Open Casting Call for the upcoming world-premiere stage production of Diva Airways: The Rise & Fall, scheduled to debut in Chicago in April 2027!

As we enter the final stages of casting, we are seeking talented, enthusiastic, and dedicated performers to join our growing theatrical company and help bring this exciting original production to life.

We welcome performers from diverse backgrounds and varying levels of theatrical experience who meet the requirements of our available roles.

As the inaugural theatrical production of FlightTime Productions, Diva Airways: The Rise & Fall represents an exciting milestone for our company. We are looking for individuals who are passionate about live theatre, enjoy collaborative storytelling, and are eager to become part of an original theatrical experience.

THIS IS AN OPEN CASTING CALL. NO APPOINTMENT OR ADVANCE REGISTRATION IS REQUIRED!

⸻

AUDITION INFORMATION

Monday, November 9, 2026

Audition Hours: 11:00 AM – 4:00 PM

Location:

West Loop Branch Library

Meeting Room

122 N. Aberdeen Street

Chicago, IL 60607

IMPORTANT CHECK-IN POLICY

Audition check-in will close promptly at 4:00 PM.

All performers must arrive and complete check-in before this cutoff. Individuals arriving after 4:00 PM will not be permitted to audition.

We strongly encourage performers to arrive early to allow sufficient time for registration and preparation.

AUDITION REQUIREMENTS

All performers attending our final open casting call should come prepared with the following:

* A 1–2 minute comedic or dramatic monologue of your choosing.

* A willingness to participate in group improvisation activities facilitated by members of our casting team.

* One current headshot.

* One current acting résumé.

Our audition process is designed to provide performers with an opportunity to showcase their acting abilities, creativity, personality, improvisational skills, and ability to collaborate with others.

We want every performer to feel welcomed, comfortable, and encouraged throughout the audition process.

ABOUT THE PRODUCTION

Diva Airways: The Rise & Fall

A Three-Act Comedy-Drama

Welcome aboard Diva Airways, where the turbulence isn’t just in the skies!

Set at Harvey International Airport, the story follows outspoken and fiercely determined airline owner Miss Loretta Monroe, who is fighting to keep her beloved airline flying high.

But behind the polished image of Diva Airways, trouble is brewing.

Between financial struggles, workplace conflicts, complicated family relationships, unexpected friendships, corporate rivalries, and a few outrageous personalities, Loretta quickly discovers that keeping an airline in business may be the least of her problems.

Blending sharp comedy with compelling drama, Diva Airways: The Rise & Fall explores ambition, loyalty, family, sacrifice, and the sometimes unpredictable cost of success.

With memorable characters, emotional storytelling, and plenty of unexpected twists, this original production promises audiences an unforgettable theatrical experience.

AVAILABLE ROLES

We are currently casting three supporting roles for our upcoming production.

All available positions are paid performance opportunities.

COLIN – Supporting Role | Paid

Colin is Alexa Winters’ brother, a caring and family-oriented young man who brings an important emotional perspective to his sister’s increasingly complicated life.

As Alexa continues dedicating herself to Diva Airways, Colin struggles to understand why she has become distant from her family.

His appearance reveals unresolved family tensions and offers audiences a deeper understanding of Alexa’s personal struggles.

Casting Requirements:

* Pronouns: He/Him

* Playing Age: 16+

* Ethnicity: Caucasian or Latino/Hispanic

* Performance Stipend: $800

TIFFANY BELMONT – Supporting Role | Paid

Tiffany Belmont is the personal assistant to Miss Brooks, the intimidating CEO of rival Backcountry Airlines.

New to the airline industry, Tiffany has a remarkable talent for finding herself in situations she doesn’t entirely understand.

Her questionable fashion choices, misplaced confidence, and unpredictable personality make her an unforgettable presence in Miss Brooks’ demanding world.

Although Tiffany may occasionally appear clueless, she brings an entertaining combination of ambition, humor, and personality to the Backcountry Airlines office.

Her introduction also gives audiences a closer look into the operations, personalities, and behind-the-scenes conflicts taking place at Diva Airways’ biggest competitor.

Casting Requirements:

* Pronouns: She/Her

* Playing Age: 16+

* Ethnicity: Open to all ethnicities

* Performance Stipend: $800

BROOKLYN – Supporting Role | Paid

Brooklyn is the daughter of Miss Brooks, the powerful CEO of rival Backcountry Airlines.

Initially caught between loyalty to her mother and her growing involvement with Diva Airways, Brooklyn finds herself questioning where her true loyalties belong.

As she becomes more familiar with Diva Airways and its employees, she begins to recognize that the struggling airline may be worth saving.

Her character brings an important emotional dimension to the rivalry between the two airlines.

Casting Requirements:

* Pronouns: She/Her

* Playing Age: 16+

* Ethnicity: Caucasian or African American

* Performance Stipend: $800

⸻

CALLBACK INFORMATION

Friday, November 13, 2026

Callback Time: 10:00 AM

Location:

Pullman Branch Library

11001 S. Indiana Avenue

Chicago, IL 60628

CALLBACKS ARE BY INVITATION ONLY.

Performers selected to advance in the casting process will receive additional instructions from our production team.

These instructions may include specific scene materials, character-related preparation, and additional performance exercises.

Callback performers may be asked to participate in scene readings alongside members of our current cast to help evaluate character interpretation, chemistry, and overall suitability for the production.

REHEARSAL & PERFORMANCE COMMITMENTS

All performers interested in joining our production must be available for the following rehearsal and performance commitments.

Rehearsals Begin: Sunday, January 10, 2027

January – February 2027

Rehearsals will take place twice per week:

* Sundays – Afternoon

* Mondays – Evening

March 2027

Rehearsals will increase to three times per week:

* Sundays – Afternoon

* Mondays – Evening

* Tuesdays – Evening

Technical Rehearsals

April 4–7, 2027

Performance Engagement

April 8 – May 30, 2027

Performances will take place Thursday through Sunday.

Please note that a potential extension beyond May 30, 2027, may be considered depending on audience response, revenue, and overall production success.

Performers should carefully review these commitments before auditioning.

IMPORTANT VENUE DISCLAIMER

West Loop Branch Library is not affiliated with, associated with, or a sponsor of FlightTime Productions or this theatrical production.

The library serves solely as the location for our casting event.

QUESTIONS & CASTING INQUIRIES

If you have any questions regarding our final open casting call, available roles, audition requirements, or production commitments, please contact:

divaairwaysstage@gmail.com

Please include “Diva Airways Casting Inquiry” in the subject line of your email.

A PERSONAL MESSAGE FROM OUR DIRECTOR

As the playwright and director of Diva Airways: The Rise & Fall, I am incredibly excited to welcome new performers into the world of this production.

This story has been developed over several years, and watching these characters come to life through the talents of our growing cast has been an incredibly rewarding experience.

We are now approaching the final stages of casting, and these remaining characters will play an important part in completing the story we are preparing to share with Chicago audiences in 2027.

Whether you are an experienced theatrical performer or someone looking for an opportunity to showcase your talents in an original stage production, I encourage you to come out and audition.

We are looking for more than just talented actors. We are looking for dedicated, creative, collaborative individuals who are excited about being part of something special.

Thank you for considering FlightTime Productions. We look forward to meeting you, seeing your performances, and potentially welcoming you aboard!

Sincerely,

Matthew Stevens

Writer & Director

Diva Airways: The Rise & Fall

FlightTime Productions

divaairwaysstage@gmail.com

WORLD PREMIERE – CHICAGO, 2027

“Where the drama is first class, the comedy is nonstop, and the turbulence is guaranteed!”

FASTEN YOUR SEATBELTS. THIS AIRLINE IS IN FOR ONE UNFORGETTABLE RIDE!

🎬 CASTING CALL — FEMALE LEAD FOR MUSIC VIDEO
📍 Location: Warsaw, Poland

Dates: 19.10-22.10 (estimate) 

Mystique Studios is casting a female lead, age 26–30, for an upcoming music video production to be filmed in Warsaw, Poland.

We are looking for a woman with:

• East European look

• Natural, innocent features

• Expressive face and comfortable presence in front of the camera

• Acting/modeling experience is welcome, but not essential

• Ability to portray natural emotion, warmth and chemistry on camera

🎥 ABOUT THE PROJECT

The music album has already been released, and we are now producing an official music video intended for YouTube, social media promotion and submission to music video/film festivals.

The shoot will take approximately 1–2 days in Warsaw, Poland.

This is an independent, low-budget production, so please apply with this in mind.

💰 COMPENSATION

This is a paid role, with cash payment depending on the selected cast member, experience and final shooting requirements.

Food, snacks and drinks will be provided during filming.

🎞️ ABOUT US

We are an independent, low-budget production studio focused on films, music and visual storytelling.

Our work includes:

• 2 completed feature films produced for the festival festivals 

• One feature officially selected at 30+ film festivals across Europe and winner of 10+ awards

• 2 released music videos

• 10+ released music albums

• Several new film, music and visual projects currently in development

📩 TO APPLY

Please send:

• Your name and age

• Prefer location - Warsaw 

• 3–5 recent photographs — preferably portrait and full-length

• Links to Instagram or other social media

• Acting/modeling/showreel links, if available

• Brief details of previous experience, if any

WhatsApp: +48 579 162 415

Email: mystiquestudios@yahoo.com

Telegram: @Mystiquestudios

Please write “MUSIC VIDEO CASTING” when contacting us.

Selected applicants may be invited for a short meeting or camera test in Warsaw before final casting.

🎬 Mystique Studios

Independent Film • Music • Visual Storytelling

Paid Casting Call for a Permanent Main Cast Role in my Miro-Budget Indie Web Series

Evangaline the Black Mage--Main Character Role-long term, Permanently Position.

Pay Rate:

£15 per hour starting from the first hour when we start filming and ending on the last hour when we have stop filming. Overtime payment is included.

Acting Description:

You'll be following my instructions during each Scene/Take as we film. Showing Body Language, Facial Expressions, and Fighting in a RPG gameplay style. You must have a good memory when saying your lines.

Filming Location(s): 

All over Milton Keynes.

The first 2 locations to start us off filming is The Plough Pub in Simpson, follow by The Crauford Arms Pub in Wolverton.

Sometimes outside of Milton Keynes if I can not find a good filming location within the area. And most times film locations need to be specific in the right film set.

How many days of Filming:

Minimal of 1 day per month. I try and do multiple days per month but it get's hard to arrange and organize a Film Date based around everyone's rota's.

Travel Payment:

Your Travel fee(s) will be covered by me coming and going from Milton Keynes but you will have to show some proof of your journey so I can give the right amount to cover your Travels.

Food and Drinks:

Food and Drinks will be provided by me, but I don't bring food and drinks since the Team has been ok bringing there own. If we are near a Local Shop, Café, Coffee Shop, or even a Fast Food Restaurant, ect. Just let me know what you like and I will pay for you.

Evangaline Character Description: 

Full Name: Evangaline Springbell

Age: 19

Class: Black Mage-(Elemental Spellcaster)

Weapon(s): Fans and Rods-(Maybe)

Character Appearance:

She wears a big Leather Brown Wizard Hat with a big Red Ribbon to the side of the Belt Buckle, a Neck Choker, and a smooth Summer Red and Black Tartan Dress with a thin small Black Jacket.

She has Black Leggings with Red and Black Socks on and her hair colour changes sometimes to match her emotions.

Her alternative clothes is a Red and Black Hell Bunny Dress. (DLC idea I have used in the past.)

Character Bio:

Evangaline is a skilful Black Mage who uses Black Magic Spells that are a variety of Elemental and Destructive Power.

She is strong-willed, courageous, and has a strong sense of determination to punish those who commit evil deeds on others with her Black Magic. Even if they are her allies and friends which makes her quite scary.

At times she losses' her cool and get's angry sometimes, losing her temper and casting a Fire Magic Spell on others, especially on Zorran who annoys her and sexualised her for being a good looking woman. Making her very fierce and those who cross her will pay with there life.

she is a bit tomboyish, imposing, sharp-tongued, and extremely blunt, always blurting what she truly thinks and feels like without reservation, even if said comments come at others' expense. She makes it a personal philosophy to always be honest as it feels better.

Relationships with other Main Characters:

(Renzu)---She has a very healthy friendship and respect to Renzu the Main Hero of the Story (Protagonist) after he helped her out for being framed for a crime she did not commit without judging her. Evangaline over time starts to development feelings towards him but still treats him like any other typical Boy as they are the same age and that Evangaline has never spent so much time with a Boy before.

(Zorran)---She doesn't like him all that much for being a drunken, lazy, childish, and perverted older man. When Zorran slaps her bum she sets his hand on fire with a fire magic spell which Zorran never learns from. Evangaline has to keep her guard up around him all the time as Zorran is unpredictable.

(Drako)--She feels Drako's pain after he lost his loved one to a Troll Monster, although Drako hasn't been part of the team for that long and she doe's not know him all too well but she enjoys his fighting spirit and resolve and get's along well with him 2nd to Renzu. Evangaline doe's not get why Drako likes Zorran that much or why his calling him "Master". She thinks he is a bit naïve.

What I'm looking for:

A Female Actress who is Capable, Committed, Not in full Education, Fit for the role, Flexible with her Rota, and is able to travel to Milton Keynes. And can travel to other locations outside Milton Keynes.

Age: 18-24

Height: 5.1 foot to 5.8 foot

Skin: White

Hair Colour: Any.

Body Type: Slim Build, Chubby, Athletic

Acting Requirements: Everybody is welcome, show me what you can do and what you know based on your Acting Experience.

Nationality: White British. Other White or British Nationality are welcome within reason.

I'm willing to let 1 or 2 slide if you don't meet the requirements, the rest will come down to a finale decision as I can't make any mistakes as this role is very important to be filled. If you don't think you can do this or can't handle it then best to step down from applying.

How to apply:

You can send a message to me directly. We can talk first, exchange information and contacts maybe, I will answer some questions that you wish to know or what I have missed in this Casting Call but not too many please as it saves time and I want to save my breath in answering questions and providing more info to those who are actually serious about this Post (No time wasters please).

After a few steps I'LL arrange a time and date to meet face to face with you if you live in or near Milton Keynes or by Video Call if you live far away like London. The chat will be about 1 hour and 30 mins.

If you are traveling to meet me in person your Travel Cost will be covered coming to Milton Keynes and going back home, which I will provide a fair sum for the time you have taken to see me on your journey.

Looking to continue filming with are new Actress as Evangaline ASAP.

Link to my Series on YouTube: https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PL5A8Ih2U1y15yAfFecmlZ4q_QsdmDLCXT&si=zU8XrRNGpXokHSDY

Thank you for taking the time to read this.

Title: *I’m Going to Beat You to Death With the Cuck Chair*

Genre: Comedy

Logline: When Douglas’s wife wants to experiment inside their relationship, he begrudgingly accepts and ends up heckled by the very chair that he is stuck sitting in. 

Roles: 

**DOUGLAS - LEAD** - *Male, 20s-40s*

A man being cucked by his own wife, much to his dismay. Drops acid and starts being heckled by the chair that he’s stuck sitting on.

**RACHEL - SUPPORTING** - *Female, 20s-40s*

Douglas’s enthusiastic, but dismissive wife, looking for a little excitement.

**CLARA - SUPPORTING** - *Female, 20s-40s*

A trash-talking, dominant sex worker, helping give Rachel a new experience.

**CHAIR - LEAD** **(VO) **- *Male, any age*

A talking chair that heckles Douglas through his entire awkward experience. VO only.

Director: Xander Raley

Production Type: Short Film

Contact Information: sirjackofalltrades@gmail.com

Run Time: Short

Compensation: Unpaid; snacks and meals will be provided, as well as a copy of final film and footage.

Union Status: Non-Union

Audition Information: We will be accepting self tape auditions at this time. Please email [sirjackofalltrades@gmail.com](mailto:sirjackofalltrades@gmail.com) with the subject line “CUCK CHAIR - ROLE NAME AUDITION” and we will provide you with sides for a self tape. Auditions are due next **Friday****, October 23th**** by ****6:00pm**.

Shooting Schedule: November 7-8th.

Filming Location: Denver/Aurora area

Content Warning: Mature themes. Simulated drug use and sexual themes. NO on screen intimacy or nudity. 18+ actors only.

items.text:
Casting a live table read for a social-justice themed project.  This has a very pro-human rights/anti-exploitation stance, so performers must be comfortable with that as the theme and mission.

Rate $100/day

Dates: 

week of October 19, one individual rehearsal with director, with scheduling flexibility for actors.

Nov 6th 8am-5pm

Nov 9th 8am-5pm

Potential Nov 10th 8am-5pm, (dependent on previous days, so availability here a huge plus!)

For all roles, looking for believability, authenticity and realism to bring these roles to life. While not an on-camera performance, these roles require on-camera subtlety and nuance.

Roles:

**Leslie:** female, mid-60's, the CEO of The Corporation, the spin doctor who easily bends the truth to make the company look good. 

**Greg:** male, 50s-60s, CFO of The Corporation, the accountant to whom people are numbers on a spreadsheet.

**Nico:** male, mid 50's-60's Security Officer for The Corporation, blue collar, former cop who has made a career of following orders and not questioning them.

To submit, please send a headshot, resume and link to sample of your work (monologue, self-tape, demo reel, etc) to CastingHRC@gmail.com, no later than Friday, October 16th. Please confirm availability for the dates.

items.text:
Mezinárodní filmový festival BRNO16 se řadí mezi nejdéle fungující filmové festivaly v České republice. Od svého založení v roce 1960 se koná nepřetržitě a zároveň patří k nejstarším přehlídkám krátkometrážní tvorby na světě. Představuje široké spektrum krátkých filmů, od hraných a animovaných až po experimentální snímky, a to jak od studentů, tak od profesionálních i neprofesionálních tvůrců. Vedle prestižní filmové soutěže nabízí také bohatý doprovodný program zahrnující výstavy, diskuse a workshopy. Festival každoročně hostí řadu českých i zahraničních osobností, které návštěvníkům umožňují nahlédnout do zákulisí své tvorby a diskutovat o filmech i zkušenostech z filmového prostředí.
___
Plánujete dorazit? 🎬
___
#kinoboxcz #kinobox #pozvánka #festival #brno16

Szukamy osób o etnicznej urodzie w wieku 5-17 lat do odgrywania scenek na nagrania/badania w Warszawie (Białołęka) w terminie 19.10-23.10.

1. Czas nagrania - 1 godzina. Przedział godzinowy od 8:00 do 16:00. Dokładny termin i godziny do uzgodnienia.
2. Zależy nam na dużej różnorodności etnicznej dzieci.
3. Wynagrodzenie za udział dziecka: 300 zł netto (płatne w ciągu 1 dnia po zleceniu — BLIK/konto bankowe).

W razie zainteresowania prosimy o wysłanie zgłoszenia dziecka, podając następujące informację:

1. Imię i nazwisko
2. Rok urodzenia
3. Miasto zamieszkania
4. Telefon kontaktowy do rodzica
5. Adres e-mail do rodzica
6. Wzrost
7. Prosimy o podanie dat i przedział godziny dyspozycyjności?
8. Minimum jedno zdjęcie

Kontakt: rekrutacja@agencjainfernal.pl
W temacie wiadomości prosimy napisać: Nagrania-Scenki

Wysłanie zgłoszenie jest jednoznaczne z wyrażeniem zgody na przetwarzanie danych osobowych w celu udziału w projekcie zgodnie z Rozporządzeniem Parlamentu Europejskiego i Rady (UE) 2016/679 z dnia 27 kwietnia 2016 r. w sprawie ochrony osób fizycznych w związku z przetwarzaniem danych osobowych i w sprawie swobodnego przepływu takich danych oraz uchylenia dyrektywy 95/46/WE (ogólne rozporządzenie o ochronie danych). Administratorem Twoich danych osobowych pozyskanych w procesie rekrutacyjnym jest Agencja Artystyczna INFERNAL. Podanie danych jest dobrowolne, w każdej chwili przysługuje Ci prawo do wglądu do danych, ich poprawiania lub usunięcia. Kontakt do administratora rekrutacja@agencjainfernal.pl.

Warszawa 🎬 Do ról epizodycznych szukamy:
🔶 Mężczyźni w wieku około 25-50 lat jako 

,,pobity mężczyzna”, ,,tata chorego dziecka”

🔶 Kobieta w wieku około 20-30 lat jako: ,,ciężarna kobieta” (może być kobieta w zaawansowanej / widocznej ciąży lub kobieta, której ,,ciążowy brzuch” nałożymy jako charakteryzacje w dniu nagrań)

🔶 Dodatkowo osoby w wieku 25-70+ lat jako lekarze, pielęgniarki, pacjenci, członkowie rodzin. 

Termin nagrań: 3 lub 4 listopada, Warszawa; 

🎬 Zapraszamy do wzięcia udziału w pięknym projekcie dla Fundacji, której misją jest nagłaśnianie problemu chorób ,,niewidzialnych” – tj. depresja, stany lękowe, wypalenie zawodowe… 

UWAGA: projekt dla Fundacji realizowany pro bono - udział w zdjęciach jest bez wynagrodzenia.

Zainteresowane i chętne osoby

📩 prosimy przesyłać zgłoszenia do wtorku 20 października - koniecznie z tytułem ,,casting FUNDACJA” - na adres mailowy:

monikalukasiewiczcasting@gmail.com 

W mailu podaj:

🔹 imię nazwisko, wiek, miasto zamieszkania

🔹 Numer kontaktowy 

🔹 Jedno aktualne ZDJĘCIE  całej sylwetki z widoczną twarzą i aktualną fryzurą 

🔹‼️ WIDEO WIZYTÓWKA (aktualna); najlepiej jako link do YouTube;

topComments.text: Cześć, jestem tatą chorego dziecka - samodzielnym opiekunem, więc nie musiałbym bardzo grać, by wejść w tę rolę. Chętnie pomogę 🥰

**With 35+ years of experience in the Los Angeles market as an acting coach, mentor, and founder of The Actor’s Lab, I know what it takes to move an acting career forward. sharedPost.text:
An in-depth, serious and enjoyable exploration into the unlimited power of the state of clown and its impact on new and experienced clowns, actors, performers of all kinds, anyone who stands in front of an audience, and those seeking ways to be in the moment with confidence, authenticity and joy.
This is a transformatory course; by embracing the methodology, you will deepen your ability to enter and stay in the state of clown in whatever context you work. 
Transformation only comes with some effort, and the course is a process that will stretch you, but one based in support, kindness, and a great deal of fun, laughter and play along the way. 
Through led exercises, improvisations, games and explorations, de Castro expertly and safely guides participants through an individual and collective process. It invites you to try new things and make mistakes in a supportive environment. 
Come prepared for challenges and change.
We support and celebrate each participant’s journey of development.
𝗕𝘆 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗲𝗻𝗱 𝗼𝗳 𝘁𝗵𝗶𝘀 𝘄𝗼𝗿𝗸𝘀𝗵𝗼𝗽, 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝘄𝗶𝗹𝗹 𝗵𝗮𝘃𝗲: 
*explored the pleasure of being present;
*confidence in risk-taking & the freedom to fail ;
*how to use the audience as your partner;
*a strong understanding of your relationship with your 
*own clown persona, that is unique and individual to you;
*a toolbox of well-defined techniques to refine your performance skills on your own and in groups;
*knowledge of how to use clowning in acting, or in any creative work within other disciplines.

বেরিয়েছিলুম হটীর সন্ধানে। ১৭ শতকের হটী বিদ্যালংকারের না আছে ছবি, না রয়েছে সঠিক তথ্যসম্বলিত ঐতিহাসিক বই। তাহলে? সবটাই কি কল্পনার আশ্রয়ে নির্মাণ করবো? তা কখনও হয়? সময়যান না-ই থাক, ১৭ শতকে যেতে না-ই পারি, ২০২৬-এ আমার আশেপাশে কি হটীর সংখ্যা কিছু কম? মাধুকরী করে তাদের থেকেই ঝুলি ভরিয়ে নিলুম এই দেবীপক্ষে। 

আজ পৌলমী হটী চট্টোপাধ্যায়ের কথা। 

I had set out in search of the Hoti.

Of Hoti Vidyalankar of the 17th century, there is no portrait, no historically accurate book with authentic information. So then? Should I construct everything purely out of imagination? Can that ever be done?

There may be no time machine, I may not be able to travel back to the 17th century, but in 2026, is there any dearth of Hotis around me? So like a madhukari - collecting alms morsel by morsel - I have filled my sack from them, in this Devi Paksha.

Today, the story of Poulami Hoti Chattopadhyay.

Im Oktober wird es schaurig schön. Am 18.10.2026 lassen wir unsere "Dunkle Seite" hervorscheinen mit dem Motto: schaurig-schön - Dark Alternative Styles

Das heißt: zeigt uns euren Alternativen Style! Ob Gothic , Punk, Emo oder einen der anderen Styles aus der Dunklen Szene!! Wir sind auf eure Styles, Looks und Accessoires gespannt.

Hi! I thought I’d share a little tool I built for myself in case it might be useful to others here.

My daughter does auditions, and I found it surprisingly hard to keep track of everything — submissions, audition requests, callbacks, holds, and shoot dates. Things get scattered across emails and messages, and I wanted one place where I could see everything and keep a history of how things were going.

So I built [CastTrack](https://casttrack.vercel.app/).

It’s a simple casting tracker for parents of young performers. I use it to keep track of where my daughter is with each project and to look back at her audition history and stats.

It’s completely free. I’m a web developer, so it was also a fun project to build for my portfolio, and honestly, I just didn’t want to pay for a tool I needed myself. I’m not planning to monetize it.

My daughter currently auditions mostly through Casting Networks, so that’s what I’ve used it with the most, but it should work with other platforms too.

It’s very much a tool I made to solve my own problem, but maybe someone else will find it useful too. If you try it, I’d love to hear what you think or what could be improved!

[https://casttrack.vercel.app/](https://casttrack.vercel.app/)
items.previewTitle: CastTrack — audition tracking for actors and their parents
items.previewDescription: Auditions come and go, and the details disappear into emails, texts and casting sites. CastTrack keeps the story: every audition adds to a growing record of submissions, callbacks, holds, bookings and everything in between — real data to look back on and compare with what is happening now.

topComments.text: Thank you for building and sharing!

Announcing auditions for:

The Savannah Sipping Society

By Jones Hope Wooten

Directed by Ben Green 

Auditions: Monday & Tuesday, October 26 & 27 @ 7:00pm

Callbacks by invitation Wednesday, October 28th @ 7:00pm

Please bring a headshot and resume and be prepared to read from the script

Please be prepared to list any and all conflicts

A hilarious, heartfelt comedy about friendship, second chances, and starting over. Four very different Southern women find themselves at a crossroads in life. After an unexpected meeting at a yoga class, they come together for an impromptu happy hour that blossoms into a weekly gathering filled with laughter, cocktails, romantic misadventures, and life-changing revelations. As they navigate personal setbacks and unexpected new beginnings, these women discover that it’s never too late to reinvent yourself—or find your people.

We are seeking four dynamic performers with strong comedic instincts, excellent timing, and the ability to balance broad comedy with genuine emotional depth. Distinct Southern character voices are required.

Performances: January 8 through 31, 2027

Thurs–Sat at 7:30pm

Sundays at 2:00pm

Saturday matinees January 16th and 30th at 2:00pm

Rehearsals at Cabrillo Playhouse in San Clemente, CA

We welcome and encourage performers of ALL races, ages, gender identities, abilities, body types and ethnicities to audition.

There is a $100 stipend offered

All audition info can be found at [https://cabrilloplayhouse.org/auditions-casting-call/](https://cabrilloplayhouse.org/auditions-casting-call/?fbclid=IwZXh0bgNhZW0CMTAAcGRvZgFicmlkETFycU1rOXdWUVQ3NVYwZTd5c3J0YwZhcHBfaWQQMjIyMDM5MTc4ODIwMDg5MgABHm2Tb8clJTpxO68zuvsQvksB_no2fy_0RkndZIF5-lmcuKAEritfk1H60_jt_aem_lUoHhYxjNHwOwByN68UZcg)

Announcing auditions for:

The Savannah Sipping Society

By Jones Hope Wooten

Directed by Ben Green 

Auditions: Monday & Tuesday, October 26 & 27 @ 7:00pm

Callbacks by invitation Wednesday, October 28th @ 7:00pm

Please bring a headshot and resume and be prepared to read from the script

Please be prepared to list any and all conflicts

A hilarious, heartfelt comedy about friendship, second chances, and starting over. Four very different Southern women find themselves at a crossroads in life. After an unexpected meeting at a yoga class, they come together for an impromptu happy hour that blossoms into a weekly gathering filled with laughter, cocktails, romantic misadventures, and life-changing revelations. As they navigate personal setbacks and unexpected new beginnings, these women discover that it’s never too late to reinvent yourself—or find your people.

We are seeking four dynamic performers with strong comedic instincts, excellent timing, and the ability to balance broad comedy with genuine emotional depth. Distinct Southern character voices are required.

Performances: January 8 through 31, 2027

Thurs–Sat at 7:30pm

Sundays at 2:00pm

Saturday matinees January 16th and 30th at 2:00pm

Rehearsals at Cabrillo Playhouse in San Clemente, CA

We welcome and encourage performers of ALL races, ages, gender identities, abilities, body types and ethnicities to audition.

There is a $100 stipend offered

All audition info can be found at [https://cabrilloplayhouse.org/auditions-casting-call/](https://cabrilloplayhouse.org/auditions-casting-call/?fbclid=IwZXh0bgNhZW0CMTAAcGRvZgFicmlkETFycU1rOXdWUVQ3NVYwZTd5c3J0YwZhcHBfaWQQMjIyMDM5MTc4ODIwMDg5MgABHm2Tb8clJTpxO68zuvsQvksB_no2fy_0RkndZIF5-lmcuKAEritfk1H60_jt_aem_lUoHhYxjNHwOwByN68UZcg)

We are currently looking for up to four actors to participate in our upcoming twilight spooky rides.
Here are the details for the position:

  - Dates: October 22, 23, 24, 29, 30, and 31

  - Hours: 4:00 PM – 6:00 PM (2 hours per day)

  - Pay: $50 per day (paid in cash)

  - Location: Silver Lake Railriders, 1381 Village Road, Silver Lake, NH 03875 (behind the Silver Lake Railroad Station)

Schedule & Responsibilities:

  - Station Actor (1): Remains at the station area and yard to haunt the arriving guests.

  - Trail Actors (3): At 4:00 PM, a rail motorcar will drop three actors off at designated acting locations along the route.

  - The Performance: The twilight railbike ride departs at 4:30 PM. Actors will scare guests on their way out and back. The rail motorcar will pick up the trail actors at the end of the run, returning everyone to the station around 6:00 PM for a final scare.

Requirements:

  - Safety rules must be strictly followed: no touching riders and maintain a safe distance from all equipment.

  - All actors (or parents/guardians for minors) must sign a standard liability release prior to participating.

I have created a spreadsheet to help organize and schedule interested actors. You can learn more about us at slrailriders.com.

Best regards,

Hank Walther

Rail Ventures

Silver Lake Railriders

items.text:
**CASTING CALL — TWO ADULT LEAD ROLES**

**Paid roles | London | January filming**

We’re casting **Father John and Michel-César** for *Castrato*, a short psychological horror film set in the 1970s.

The story follows a young orphan whose extraordinary singing voice brings him into the care of a celebrated choir director. What initially feels like belonging becomes a disturbing betrayal of trust. The short introduces the world and characters of *Castrato*, with the aim of developing their story into a feature film.

**FATHER JOHN — Male, playing age 50s**
A strangely attractive priest who runs the boys’ orphanage. Charming yet immediately unsettling, Father John has peculiar habits, nervous twitches and a menacing presence even when smiling. We’re looking for an actor who can embrace his strangeness without becoming cartoonish, creating discomfort through small gestures and changes in expression.

**MICHEL-CÉSAR — Male, playing age 60s**
A prestigious French choir director with a warm, almost grandfatherly presence. Meticulous about order and devoted to his choir, Michel initially feels kind and trustworthy. Gradually, subtle shifts reveal something darker beneath that warmth. We need an actor whose performance allows the unease to creep up on the audience rather than being obvious from the start.

Applicants should be based in or around **London**. Filming is expected to take place across a few weekends in **January**, with exact dates TBC. Both roles are **paid**, with rates TBC.

**TO APPLY**
Actors or agents should email:
* A headshot
* Age and location
* A CV and/or showreel link

**Email:** [castratofilm@gmail.com](mailto:castratofilm@gmail.com)
**Subject:** CASTRATO CASTING — [ROLE]

Selected applicants will receive audition material and self-tape instructions.

**Content note:** The film contains sensitive themes and violence, with no nudity or explicit surgical content. Please get in touch with any questions about the material.

Please feel free to share with anyone who may be suitable!

EPIZODYSTKI I EPIZODYŚCI – ROLKI / TIKTOK / IG

Szanowni Państwo!

Na środę, 21 października 

poszukujemy epizodystek i epizodystów 

do krótkiej formy komercyjnej realizowanej 
na potrzeby kanałów TikTok i Instagram (IG).

🎥 KOGO SZUKAMY?

✅ Kobiet i mężczyzn w wieku 25–50 lat 

✅ Osób polskojęzycznych 

✅ Osób posiadających doświadczenie w pracy przed kamerą

Poszukujemy osób do wielu różnych ról, 
które wcielą się w postaci pracowników 
i klientów marketu.

💰 WYNAGRODZENIE: 500–1000 zł netto

Stawka uzależniona jest od przypisanej postaci i zakresu roli. 
Po zakwalifikowaniu zgłoszonych osób 
do konkretnych postaci skontaktujemy się 
z wybranymi osobami i poinformujemy je 
o proponowanej stawce.

📍 MIEJSCE REALIZACJI: Warszawa

📅 TERMIN: środa, 21 października 

🕘 GODZINY: pierwsza połowa dnia

📩 JAK SIĘ ZGŁOSIĆ?

Osoby zainteresowane i dyspozycyjne prosimy 
o przesłanie zgłoszenia w wiadomości e-mail 

na adres:  📧 abcastingab@gmail.com

📭📭📭📭📭📭📭📭📭📭📭📭📭📭

W zgłoszeniu prosimy wpisać:

• Temat: ROLKI  21. 10
• Imię i nazwisko
• Wiek
• Numer telefonu
• Zdjęcie twarzy oraz zdjęcie całej sylwetki
• Informację o doświadczeniu w pracy przed kamerą
• Linki do materiałów wideo, na których można Państwa zobaczyć i usłyszeć

🎬 Poszukujemy osób do wielu postaci — jeśli masz doświadczenie przed kamerą i jesteś dyspozycyjny/a w środę, serdecznie zapraszamy do zgłoszeń!

Do zobaczenia na planie! 🎥🤝

Szukam aktorek do zagrania głównych postaci w filmie dyplomowym (non-profit)!

POSZUKIWANI:

-3 BLONDYNKI (17-25 lat)

-3 BRUNETKI (17-25 lat)

-CHŁOPAK (17-25 lat)

-DZIEWCZYNA (17-25 lat)

-PAN Z KWIATAMI (45-70 lat)

Lokalizacja: Warszawa 

Dwie przyjaciółki rozmawiają o tym co je denerwuje w kinie. Po drodze zauważają dwie dziewczyny łudząco podobne do nich, więc postanawiają je śledzić. Jadą za nimi tramwajem, obserwują do jakiej kawiarni idą, wchodzą w role szpiegów. Przysłuchując się ich rozmowom o filmach, coraz bardziej zaczynają kwestionować swoje poglądy. Czy to są ich sobowtórki?

Film będzie realizowany w eksperymentalnej konwencji zderzenia dwóch stylów filmowych. Sceny z przyjaciółkami w stylu realistycznym, natomiast z sobowtórkami -  w formalistycznym. Czas trwania: 5-10 minut. Na obrazku stylistyczne inspiracje 

To projekt dyplomowy do liceum plastycznego i z zamiarem wysyłania na festiwale.

Zainteresowanych proszę o kontakt priv lub przez ig: julkacatt - wyślę scenariusz. 

Moje prace filmowe i fotograficzne: atomosfoto na ig

Nie musisz mieć dużego doświadczenia, jeśli spodobał ci się pomysł i widzisz siebie w jednej z ról, śmiało pisz

CASTING CALL – PAID LIFESTYLE PHOTOSHOOT
New Jersey | November 16 and/or 17, 2026

Compensation: $250 per person, per shoot day + travel, meals & professional photos!

We are looking for 8 friendly, outgoing individuals to participate in a professional lifestyle photoshoot for our growing meal delivery service!

We want to capture genuine, everyday moments of people enjoying fresh, delicious meals at home with their loved ones.

WHO WE'RE CASTING
Senior Couple – 2 People

Ideally ages 65+

Comfortable portraying a loving couple enjoying meals together

Real couples are encouraged to apply!

Young Adult Couple – 2 People

Ideally ages 25–40

Comfortable portraying a couple enjoying a healthy, convenient lifestyle

Real couples welcome!

Family – 4 People

2 adults, ideally ages 30–45

2 children, ideally ages 4–12

Real families strongly encouraged to apply!

No professional modeling or acting experience required! We are looking for natural smiles, warm personalities, and people who feel comfortable in front of a camera.

SHOOT DETAILS
Location: New Jersey (exact location provided to selected participants)

Dates: Monday, November 16 and/or Tuesday, November 17, 2026

Shoot Type: Professional lifestyle photography for a meal delivery brand

Duration: Up to one full shoot day per participant; final schedule to be confirmed

COMPENSATION & PERKS
$250 CASH per person, per shoot day, paid at the end of the shoot

Round-trip Amtrak transportation provided for selected participants traveling by train

Complimentary meals and refreshments during the shoot

Copies of professionally edited photos for your personal portfolio

Fun, friendly, professional atmosphere!

HOW TO APPLY
Please send:

Your name and age (ages of children if applying as a family)

Your city/state

Which role you're applying for (Senior Couple, Young Couple, or Family)

Two or three recent, clear photos of yourself or your group

Your availability for November 16 and/or 17

Any previous modeling or acting experience (not required)

Apply by emailing or commenting here: Shana@healthyfreshmeals.com 

Selected applicants will receive additional details regarding scheduling, transportation, wardrobe, and the shoot location.

We look forward to meeting you!

Participants will be required to sign a standard photography/model release permitting the use of images in our company's advertising, website, social media, and other marketing materials. A parent or legal guardian must sign for participating minors.

Age Range: 28-45 years old.

Contact info or social media handles (Instagram/Portfolio).

Looking forward to hearing from you!

**CASTING CALL: *****SEVEN DEUCE***

**Format:** Short Film / 1970s Neo-Noir Crime Thriller

**Location:** Watkins,CO

**Shoot Dates:** November 14th and 15th

**Pay:** Paid / Non-Union Meals, Footage, and Credit provided

**Logline:** In 1975, a fortified, high-stakes underground poker game spirals out of control when greed, blackmail, undercover surveillance, and paranoia explode into a bloody 3:00 AM standoff.

**OPEN ROLES**
* **SEAT 1: THE NAMELESS VET (Male, 30s)**
* Lean, hardened, haunted. A Vietnam veteran with a dead-eyed thousand-yard stare and lethal military stillness. Speaks in a flat, quiet rasp. Economy of movement; thinks like an ambush survivor.
* **SEAT 2: JIMMY "SPRINTS" (Male, Late 20s–Early 30s)**
* Gaunt, manic, hyperactive, constantly drenched in sweat. A compulsive degenerate gambler in way over his head with loan sharks. Swings wildly between manic euphoria and breathless terror. Big physical and emotional range.
* **SEAT 3: AGENT KANE / "MILLER" (Male, 30s)**
* Sharp, handsome, tailored, cool under pressure. An undercover federal agent wearing a wire, desperately trying to keep his cover intact while counting down the minutes to a tactical raid. Needs an exceptional, subtle poker face.
* **SEAT 4: LEONARD SMOOTHS (Black Male, Late 30s–Early 40s)**
* Tall, imposing, velvet street elegance. A charismatic, stylish pimp with an icy, calculating demeanor. Commands the room with a smooth baritone, but possesses explosive, bare-knuckle violence when pushed.
* **SEAT 5: FRANK "NUMBERS" (Male, 50s–60s)**
* Broad, gravel-voiced mob veteran with horn-rimmed glasses and cold calculation. Treats the high-stakes game like an accounting spreadsheet. The calmest, smartest criminal in the cellar.
* **SEAT 6: RAY "SOLLY" SULLIVAN (Male, 40s–50s)**
* Heavyset, greasy, sweat-soaked, brutal. A deeply corrupt detective who uses his badge as a weapon of extortion and street bullying. Vicious, loud, remorseless, and arrogant.
* **THE DEALER (Female or Male, Late 30s–40s)**
* Sharp, immaculate, surgical. Total mechanical precision with cards and zero visible emotion. Commands absolute authority over dangerous, armed men through icy house rules.
* **WALTER / THE HEAVY (Male, 40s–50s)**
* Imposing, broad, weathered 230+ lb enforcer guarding the cellar door with a shotgun. A man of few words with terrifying physical presence.
**HOW TO SUBMIT**

Please email your **Headshot, Resume, and Reel (or self-tape link)** to:

📧 **tyler.j.stewart14@gmail.com**

**Subject Line:** *7DEUCE - [Role Name] - [Your Full Name]*

*Sides and self-tape instructions will be sent upon review. Feel free to share or tag talent who fit these period roles!*

* **SEAT 3: AGENT KANE / "MILLER" (Male, 30s)**
* Sharp, handsome, tailored, cool under pressure. An undercover federal agent wearing a wire, desperately trying to keep his cover intact while counting down the minutes to a tactical raid. Needs an exceptional, subtle poker face.
* **SEAT 4: LEONARD SMOOTHS (Black Male, Late 30s–Early 40s)**
* Tall, imposing, velvet street elegance. A charismatic, stylish pimp with an icy, calculating demeanor. Commands the room with a smooth baritone, but possesses explosive, bare-knuckle violence when pushed.
* **SEAT 5: FRANK "NUMBERS" (Male, 50s–60s)**
* Broad, gravel-voiced mob veteran with horn-rimmed glasses and cold calculation. Treats the high-stakes game like an accounting spreadsheet. The calmest, smartest criminal in the cellar.
* **SEAT 6: RAY "SOLLY" SULLIVAN (Male, 40s–50s)**
* Heavyset, greasy, sweat-soaked, brutal. A deeply corrupt detective who uses his badge as a weapon of extortion and street bullying. Vicious, loud, remorseless, and arrogant.
* **THE DEALER (Female or Male, Late 30s–40s)**
* Sharp, immaculate, surgical. Total mechanical precision with cards and zero visible emotion. Commands absolute authority over dangerous, armed men through icy house rules.
* **WALTER / THE HEAVY (Male, 40s–50s)**
* Imposing, broad, weathered 230+ lb enforcer guarding the cellar door with a shotgun. A man of few words with terrifying physical presence.
**HOW TO SUBMIT**

Please email your **Headshot, Resume, and Reel (or self-tape link)** to:

📧 **tyler.j.stewart14@gmail.com**

**Subject Line:** *7DEUCE - [Role Name] - [Your Full Name]*

*Sides and self-tape instructions will be sent upon review. Feel free to share or tag talent who fit these period roles!*

**SEEKING ACTORS FOR STUDENT PRODUCED TELEVISION SHOW**

**Title:** The Bluffs: Season 13

**Genre:** Dramedy

**Logline: **A punk rocker down on his luck and his funds starts rigging bets using UCCS’s new betting app to pay his mounting pile of bills.

**Roles: **

**HAYDEN: (18-24 YEARS OLD) - MALE, ANY ETHNICITY**

A STRUGGLING PUNK ROCK MUSICIAN. REBELLIOUS AND IMPULSIVE, HE IS TORN BETWEEN BEING FINANCIALLY STABLE AND LIVING AN AUTHENTIC PUNK LIFESTYLE ***THIS ROLE REQUIRES SINGING**

**GRACE: (18-24 YEARS OLD) - FEMALE, ANY ETHNICITY**

HAYDEN’S BEST FRIEND, ROOMMATE, AND BANDMATE. SHE IS QUIETLY CONFIDENT AND HAS A STRONG SENSE OF HER OWN MORALS. VERY PUNK.

**DARBY: (18-24 YEARS OLD) - FEMALE, ANY ETHNICITY**

HAYDEN’S COWORKER WHO IS IN A COMPETING PUNK BAND, ALTHOUGH YOU PROBABLY WOULDN’T KNOW THAT BY LOOKING AT HER. VERY BUSINESS MINDED, SHE IS MORE INTERESTED IN BEING A MUSICIAN FOR THE MONEY AND CLOUT THAN FOR THE ARTISTIC EXPRESSION.

**JP: (30-50 YEARS OLD) - MALE, ANY ETHNICITY**

HAYDEN AND DARBY’S BOSS AND THE BRAIN BEHIND UCCS’ NEW BLUFFBETS APP. A MIDDLE-AGED TECH BRO WHO DESPERATELY TRIES TO BE HIP AND APPEAL TO HIS STUDENT EMPLOYEES.

**Production Company:** UCCS Digital Filmmaking Program

**Production Type: **Student Television Show

**Contact Information:** vsmith@uccs.edu

**Run Time: **Television Show, three 10ish minute episdodes

**Compensation: **Unpaid

**Union Status:** Non-Union

**Audition Information:** October 24th from 2 pm to 7 pm at UCCS, by appointment only: 

https://calendly.com/vsmith-uccs/bluffsseason13audition

Shooting Schedule:

October 31st, 9AM-7PM

November 7th, 9AM-7PM

November 14th, 9AM-7PM

November 21st, 9AM-7PM

December 5th, 9AM-7PM

December 12th, 9AM-7PM

December 19th, 9AM-7PM

***Shoot dates called will depend on the role. Please look at each character to see how frequently we expect you to be called based on the character you audition for**

**Filming Location:** Various, mostly on the UCCS campus, every location with be in Colorado Springs.

**Project Description:** Every year, the UCCS Digital Filmmaking program produces a three episode anthology television show called The Bluffs. Students write, film, and edit the show from start to finish.

sharedPost.text:
🎤❤️ Musik verbindet – Menschen, Herzen und Traditionen! ❤️🎶

Beim wunderschönen Gesangswettbewerb „Lichtkegel“ durften wir Katinka kennenlernen. ✨ Sie hat uns erzählt, wie ihre musikalische Reise begann und was sie ganz besonders macht: das Jodeln! 🏔️🎵

In einer Zeit, in der Volksmusik leider nicht mehr überall im Mittelpunkt steht, finden wir es umso schöner, dass es Menschen wie Katinka gibt, die diese besondere musikalische Tradition mit so viel Leidenschaft und Herz weiterleben. ❤️🎶

Vielen Dank, liebe Katinka, für diesen wunderbaren Einblick in deine musikalische Welt! 🥰

👉 Noch viel mehr gibt es auf unserem JSW Fernsehen YouTube-Kanal! Dort findet ihr das komplette Interview mit Katinka sowie unseren gesamten Beitrag mit vielen weiteren wunderbaren Sängerinnen und Sängern. Freut euch auf tolle Begegnungen, bewegende Geschichten und jede Menge Musik! 🎤🎼

📺 JSW Fernsehen
📻 Radio Heimat – Musik mit Herz! ❤️

https://youtu.be/_kUUv1bjymI?is=ZBt0vCGU6rVx-Sv7

✨ Wir verbinden Musik, Unterhaltung und Menschen – mit Herz, Leidenschaft und ganz viel Gefühl! ✨

items.text:
We are working with the lovely team at Raw Research casting an exciting ITV x PayPal Christmas campaign, and we’re looking for bubbly, fun-loving families (e.g. adult siblings, adults with their parents, couples with children aged 16+, friends and housemates who love Christmas and go the extra mile to make it memorable. We’re particularly keen to hear from adults in their 40s and 50s - though all ages are welcome.

You might be a couple with children aged 16 or older, adult siblings, or grown-up children celebrating with their parents. Whatever your set-up, we’d love to meet people who enjoy a laugh, love ITV and already have plans for this Christmas.

We are looking for people who are London-based or about 90 minutes outside of London.

Do you have a Christmas dilemma we could help with?
Perhaps your adult child has a new partner joining Christmas lunch and you have no idea what to buy them? Maybe you’re determined to surprise your mum or sibling but have run out of ideas? Or perhaps you want to make a friend’s Christmas extra special and need some inspiration!

We’d ideally spend a day filming at your home, having fun planning presents, putting up decorations and calling ITV for help with your Christmas dilemmas. There may even be a quiz about ITV presenters, so a love of ITV and a willingness to be a bit silly are essential!

Filming - Dates TBC but 5th or 6th OR 9th are 10th of November are likely.

Payment:
£350 per person, per filming day.
£2,000 per person if you appear in the final ad campaign.
£500 per household if filming takes place in your home.
Eligibility:
Everyone taking part must be aged 16 or over. Ideally adults in their 40s and 50s!
Participants must be eligible for a PayPal account and have used PayPal or be familiar with it.
Participants must have no adverse credit history, history of debt or financial vulnerability.
Participants must have no current or previous affiliations with competing financial brands.
Interested? Please contact casting@rawresearch.co.uk, telling us who you’d take part with, what makes Christmas special to you and the Christmas dilemma you’d love help with. Please also send a photo of everyone applying, a simple selfie will do!
Thank you

Casting actors for roles including **MC (female, 20s)**, **Friend (female, 20s)**, and **Lawyer (male, 40s)**. Short film script focusing on a post-incident interrogation and flashbacks revealing a home invasion and murder. The piece centers on trauma, memory, and an unsettling ambiguity in the protagonist’s behavior.

***Shoot dates in Early November 2026 and locations in Central London.***

*This is a bare-bones production, shooting over 1, possibly two days. We will provide water, snacks, and pizza. Thank you for your understanding!*

MC
* Lead
* Female
* 20-29
* **Role description: **A traumatized young woman who recounts a home invasion and the murder of her friend during an interrogation. She alternates between sobbing, flashback memories, and unsettling moments of composure and smirks that suggest complex emotional states.
* **Audition Requirements: **Please record an emotional monologue of your choosing, no more than 60 seconds. If you can cry on command, please showcase it. Send in a one-page resume/CV.

Friend
* Supporting
* Female
* 20-29
* **Role description: **The younger woman who attempts to escape during the home invasion and is later found dead; appears in flashbacks and is central to MC’s trauma.
* **Audition Requirements: **Please record an emotional monologue of your choosing, no more than 60 seconds. Send in one-page resume/CV.

Lawyer
* Supporting
* Male
* 40-49
* **Role description: **The interrogator who calmly questions MC and takes notes during the session; provides reassurance and guidance during questioning.
* **Audition Requirements: **Please record a dramatic monologue of your choosing, no more than 60 seconds. Send in one-page resume/CV.

CONTACT: EH.Castings@gmail.com
